
# IE (6千字)

将IE安全”选项的“自定义”和“默认”"按钮恢复成可以按

（该按钮原来是灰色的，不可按）

```asm
.386

.model flat,stdcall

option casemap:none

include \masm32\include\windows.inc

include \masm32\include\user32.inc

include \masm32\include\kernel32.inc
include \masm32\include\gdi32.inc
include \masm32\include\comctl32.inc

include \masm32\include\comdlg32.inc

include \masm32\include\shell32.inc
include \masm32\include\advapi32.inc


includelib \masm32\lib\user32.lib

includelib \masm32\lib\kernel32.lib
includelib \masm32\lib\gdi32.lib
includelib \masm32\lib\comctl32.lib

includelib \masm32\lib\comdlg32.lib

includelib \masm32\lib\shell32.lib
includelib \masm32\lib\advapi32.lib

.data
SubKey
db 'Software\Policies\Microsoft\Internet Explorer',0
RegKey
    db "Control Panel",0
MsgCap        db "Fix
Your IE Ver 0.1      by WsCn",0
MsgOK
    db "Fixed OK!",0
MsgFailed      db "Sorry, Fix
failed Perhaps your IE is not been Locked！",0
lhHRootUser    dd
0
hInstance      dd 0

.code
start:

invoke GetModuleHandle,NULL
mov hInstance,eax
call ModifyIt
invoke
ExitProcess,NULL

ModifyIt Proc
        pushad
       invoke RegOpenKeyEx,HKEY_CURRENT_USER,ADDR SubKey,NULL,KEY_ALL_ACCESS,ADDR
lhHRootUser
      .if !eax
          invoke
RegDeleteKey,lhHRootUser,ADDR RegKey
          .if !eax

              invoke MessageBox,NULL,addr MsgOK,addr
MsgCap,MB_OK
              jmp Modi_exit
         .endif
      .endif

     invoke MessageBox,NULL,addr MsgFailed,addr MsgCap,MB_OK
 Modi_exit:

      invoke RegCloseKey,lhHRootUser
      popad
     ret
 ModifyIt Endp

 end start
```

编译好的代码(可以用WINHEX存为`FixIE.exe`)：

```

```
